definitions.explanation: Describes behavior, actions, or a person that is rough, aggressive, or lacking in manners. Implies a combination of physical roughness and social crudeness.

examples.japanese: {粗暴|そぼう}な⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧はやめ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反|はん}して→反する：11966_hansuru⟧{粗暴|そぼう}な⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧だった。
examples.english: Contrary to his appearance, he was a rough person.

examples.japanese: {粗暴|そぼう}な⟦{言動|げんどう}→言動：14147_gendou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{敬遠|けいえん}→敬遠：12930_keien⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Due to his rough behavior and language, people started avoiding him.

notes:
USAGE:
{粗暴|そぼう} describes a combination of physical roughness and crude behavior. It is stronger than ⟦{乱暴|らんぼう}→乱暴：02482_ranbou⟧ (rough, violent) in implying a persistent character trait rather than a single action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粗暴|そぼう}な⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ (rough/violent behavior)
- {粗暴|そぼう}な⟦{言動|げんどう}→言動：14147_gendou⟧ (rough words and actions)
- {粗暴|そぼう}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (rough personality)
- {粗暴|そぼう}{犯|はん} (violent crime — legal term)
